passport.name: People
items: Person with a cane or walker

passport.name: Animals
items: Horses or livestock at a distance

retrieve.name: Retriever type
retrieve.reward: Food, and a thrown toy as a bonus
retrieve.watch: mouthing, breaking on thrown things, door dashing

point.name: Pointing type
point.reward: Food; a flirt pole for play
point.watch: range on walks, recall around bird scent

flush.name: Flushing spaniel type
flush.watch: range, staying steady when something flies

scent.name: Scent hound type
scent.watch: recall with the nose down, howling

sight.name: Sighthound type
sight.reward: Food; a lure toy for play
sight.watch: chasing small animals, recall in open spaces

herd.name: Herding type
herd.reward: Toys and tug; food works too

companion.name: Companion type
companion.watch: potty training, being left alone, jumping up

skills.name: Name
skills.goal: Eyes on you when you say their name.
skills.cue: Their name, said once in a happy voice.
skills.proofMark: they look at you after their name, said once.

steps.mark: your dog looks at your face on their own.
steps.setup: Quiet room, treats ready, say nothing. Just wait.
steps.reward: Hand the treat at your chest so their eyes come back up to you.

steps.mark: they turn their head toward you after you say their name.
steps.setup: Wait until they glance away (not busy sniffing), say the name once.

steps.mark: they look at you after their name, with a toy on the floor nearby.
steps.setup: Toy or another person in the room. Say the name once. No repeats.
steps.reward: Treat at your chest. If they don't look in 3 s, move closer.

steps.mark: they look or start toward you from across the room.
steps.setup: They're 3 to 5 m away, not busy. Name once.
steps.reward: Catch works here: toss the treat toward them.

steps.mark: they look at you after their name in the yard or on the sidewalk.
steps.setup: On leash, a quiet spot first. Name once.

skills.name: Hand target
skills.goal: Nose to your palm. A handy way to move them anywhere.
skills.proofMark: their nose hits your palm on "Touch".

steps.mark: their nose touches your flat palm.
steps.setup: Hold a flat palm 5 cm from their nose. Most dogs sniff it right away.
steps.reward: Treat from your OTHER hand, then hide the palm behind your back and present again.

steps.mark: they move to bump your palm held 20 to 30 cm to the left, right, up or low.
steps.setup: Change the spot each rep.

steps.mark: they bump your palm after you say "Touch".
steps.setup: Say "Touch", then present the palm. Word first, hand second.

steps.mark: their nose hits your palm after they walk 2 or 3 steps to it.
steps.setup: Step away, say "Touch", hold the palm out.

steps.mark: they touch on cue in a new room or outside.
steps.setup: Use Touch to move them off the couch, past a dog, or through a door.

skills.name: Sit
skills.goal: Rear on the floor, from a word.
skills.proofMark: they sit on one cue.

steps.mark: the rear touches the floor.
steps.setup: Treat at their nose, move it slowly up and back over the head. The rear drops as the head goes up.
steps.reward: Give the lure treat while they're still sitting.

steps.mark: the rear touches the floor.
steps.setup: Same hand motion, no treat in that hand.
steps.reward: Treat from your other hand or pouch, delivered while they sit.

steps.mark: the rear touches the floor after a small upward flick of your hand.
steps.setup: Make the motion smaller each rep, standing up straight.

steps.mark: the rear touches the floor.
steps.setup: Say "Sit" once, wait half a second, THEN give the hand signal.
steps.reward: Treat while they sit. Soon they'll sit before the signal.

steps.mark: they sit after "Sit" with your hands still.
steps.setup: Hands at your sides. If no sit in 3 seconds, go back a step.

steps.mark: they've held the sit until the timer marks it.
steps.setup: Ask for Sit, then start the hold. Tap Miss if they get up.
steps.reward: Yes is their release. Hand the treat over right away.

steps.mark: they sit on one cue in the yard, a hallway, the sidewalk.
steps.setup: New place = easier step. Start with the hand signal again if needed.

skills.name: Down
skills.goal: Elbows on the floor, from a word.
skills.proofMark: they lie down on one cue.

steps.mark: both elbows touch the floor.
steps.setup: From a sit, move a treat from their nose straight down between the front paws, then slowly along the floor.
steps.reward: Give the treat on the floor between their paws.

steps.mark: both elbows touch the floor.
steps.setup: Same motion, no treat in that hand.
steps.reward: Treat from the other hand, placed between their paws.

steps.mark: the elbows touch after you point at the floor while standing taller.
steps.setup: Bend less each rep.
steps.reward: Treat on the floor between the paws.

steps.mark: both elbows touch the floor.
steps.setup: Say "Down" once, pause half a second, then give the signal.

steps.mark: they lie down after "Down" with your hands still.
steps.setup: If nothing in 3 seconds, go back a step.

steps.mark: they go down on one cue somewhere new.
steps.setup: Soft ground first (grass, a mat). Hard floors are harder.

skills.name: Stay
skills.goal: Hold a sit or down until you release them.
skills.cue: "Stay". Yes is the release (or Free, to end without a treat).
skills.proofMark: they're still in position when the timer marks it.

steps.mark: they're still sitting when the timer marks it.
steps.setup: Ask for Sit, say "Stay", start the hold. Stand right in front of them.
steps.reward: Yes ends the stay. Treat right away; getting up after Yes is fine.

steps.mark: they're still sitting when the timer marks it.
steps.setup: Same, but the time varies so they can't guess the end. Tap Miss if they get up.
steps.reward: Yes ends the stay. Treat right away.

steps.mark: you've stepped back, returned, and they're still sitting.
steps.setup: Say "Stay", one step back, step back in. Mark when you're back beside them.
steps.reward: Yes ends the stay. Treat right away.

steps.mark: you've walked 3 to 5 steps away and back and they're still sitting.
steps.setup: Going farther? Keep the time short.
steps.reward: Treat as soon as you're back beside them. Never call them out of a stay.

steps.mark: they hold the stay while you drop a toy, clap, or knock.
steps.setup: Stand close again. Distraction up = distance and time down.
steps.reward: Yes ends the stay. Treat right away.

steps.mark: they hold a short stay somewhere new.
steps.setup: Start at the Tiny hold level in each new place.
steps.reward: Yes ends the stay. Treat right away.

skills.name: Come
skills.goal: Run to you every time you call.
skills.cue: Name + "Come", once. The Recall whistle is for emergencies.
skills.proofMark: they run all the way to you on one call.

steps.mark: their front feet reach you.
steps.setup: 2 to 3 m away. Say name + "Come" once, take a step backward, clap if needed.
steps.reward: Treat at your knees, then touch their collar.

steps.mark: you hold their collar and they stay with you.
steps.setup: Call, then gently take the collar. This keeps recall from meaning "fun is over".
steps.reward: Treat while you hold the collar, then let go.

steps.mark: they arrive from another room.
steps.setup: Call once from out of sight.
steps.reward: Two or three treats in a row. Arriving should feel great.

steps.mark: they turn and run to you in the yard or park.
steps.setup: 5 to 10 m line, call when they're not busy sniffing.
steps.reward: Jackpot: several treats or a toy game.

steps.mark: they leave a smell to come to you.
steps.setup: Long line. If they don't turn in 3 s, go back a step. Never reel them in angry.
steps.reward: Jackpot, then send them back to the sniff.

skills.name: Leave it
skills.goal: Back off whatever you point out.
skills.proofMark: they leave it on one cue and look back at you.

steps.mark: their nose moves away from your closed fist.
steps.setup: Treat in a closed fist at their nose level. Let them lick and nudge. Say nothing. Wait.
steps.reward: Treat from your OTHER hand. Never from the fist.

steps.mark: they back off the treat on your open palm.
steps.setup: Open your palm. If they dive in, close it. Wait for them to pull back.

steps.mark: they look away after "Leave it".
steps.setup: Say "Leave it" once as you show the fist or palm.

steps.mark: they look away from a treat on the floor, or look at you.
steps.setup: Drop a treat, foot ready to cover it. "Leave it" once.
steps.reward: Treat from your hand, never the one on the floor.

steps.mark: they walk past a treat on the floor without lunging.
steps.setup: On leash, walk past at a distance they can manage, then closer.
steps.reward: Treat at your side as you pass.

steps.mark: they leave wrappers, food or droppings on a walk.
steps.setup: On leash, spot it before they do and cue early.

skills.name: Drop it
skills.goal: Let go of what's in their mouth.
skills.proofMark: they let go on one cue.

steps.mark: the toy leaves their mouth.
steps.setup: Play tug or fetch with a so-so toy. Put a great treat at their nose.
steps.reward: Give the treat, then give the toy back. Getting it back is the secret.

steps.mark: the toy leaves their mouth after "Drop".
steps.setup: Say "Drop", then show the treat.

steps.mark: they let go after "Drop" with no treat in sight.
steps.setup: Treat in your pouch or pocket.

steps.mark: they drop their favorite toy.
steps.setup: Use your best food.

steps.mark: they drop a sock, stick or found object.
steps.setup: Don't chase. Calm voice, "Drop", show food.
steps.reward: Your best treat. Then swap the item for a toy.

skills.name: Loose leash
skills.goal: Walk with a slack leash.
skills.cue: None needed; a slack leash is the cue.
skills.proofMark: the leash stays slack.

steps.mark: the leash hangs slack, or they glance at you.
steps.setup: Leash on, stand in a hallway or yard. Don't move.
steps.reward: Treat at your pant seam on the side they walk.

steps.mark: they're beside you with a slack leash after you take a step.
steps.setup: One step, stop. Repeat.

steps.mark: the leash is still slack after 2 or 3 steps.
steps.setup: High rate: mark often. Keep going between marks is fine.
steps.reward: Treat at your seam, without stopping.

steps.mark: the leash goes slack again after you stopped.
steps.setup: When the leash gets tight, freeze. Wait for slack, mark, then walk on.
steps.reward: Treat at your seam, then walk.

steps.mark: they catch up to your side after you turn around.
steps.setup: Turn and walk the other way, cheerfully.

steps.mark: the leash stays slack for a few steps outside.
steps.setup: Short walks, many marks. A sniff break (Free) is a reward too.
steps.reward: Treat at your seam, or Free to sniff.

skills.name: Mat and settle
skills.goal: Go to a mat and relax there.
skills.proofMark: they're still relaxed on the mat when the timer marks it.

steps.mark: they look at or sniff the mat.
steps.setup: Put a towel or mat down. Wait.
steps.reward: Tap Catch and toss the treat onto the mat.

steps.mark: one paw touches the mat.
steps.setup: Wait for it. Don't lure.
steps.reward: Catch: toss the treat onto the mat.

steps.mark: all four paws are on the mat.
steps.setup: Wait for the full step-on.
steps.reward: Treat on the mat, between the front paws.

steps.mark: they lie down on the mat.
steps.setup: Cue Down if they know it, otherwise wait.
steps.reward: Treat between the paws on the mat.

steps.mark: they're still lying on the mat when the timer marks it.
steps.setup: Sit nearby. Tap Miss if they leave.
steps.reward: Yes ends it. Treat between the paws.

steps.mark: they go to the mat when you say "Mat" from a meter away.
steps.setup: Say "Mat", point. Increase the distance slowly.

steps.mark: they're relaxed on the mat: head down, hips rolled to one side.
steps.setup: Sit on the couch with a book or TV. Calm, slow pace.
steps.reward: Mark softly or just place a treat between the paws every 30 to 60 s. Calm is the goal.

skills.name: Place
skills.goal: Go to a raised bed or board and stay there. The base for duck blinds, boats and calm at home.
skills.proofMark: they're still on the board when the timer marks it.

steps.mark: both front paws touch the board or cot.
steps.setup: A raised board, cot or low step. Lure toward it once, then wait for the paws.
steps.reward: Treat while the paws are on it.

steps.mark: all four paws are on the board.
steps.setup: Wait for the back feet to climb on. Don't lure this time.
steps.reward: Treat on the board, between the front paws.

steps.mark: they lie down on the board.
steps.setup: Once they're on, ask for Down.
steps.reward: Treat between the paws, on the board.

steps.mark: they've stayed on the board until the timer marks it.
steps.setup: Say "Place", start the hold. Tap Miss if they step off.
steps.reward: Yes releases them. Treat on the board.

steps.mark: they go to the board when you say "Place" from 3 m away.
steps.setup: Point once. Add distance a step at a time.

skills.name: Wait
skills.goal: Pause at doors, the car and the food bowl until released.
skills.proofMark: they wait until you say "OK".

steps.mark: they stay put as you open the door a crack.
steps.setup: Leash on, dog at the door. Open 5 cm. If they move toward it, close it gently.
steps.reward: Treat from your hand, back away from the door.

steps.mark: they stay while the door is fully open for a second.
steps.setup: Open it wide, count one, close it.

steps.mark: they wait until you say "OK", then go through.
steps.setup: Open, count 3, say OK and walk through together.
steps.reward: Going through is the reward; add a treat on the other side.

steps.mark: they wait in the car with the door open until released.
steps.setup: Leash on, someone holding it the first few times.
steps.reward: Treat in the car, then release.

steps.mark: they wait while you set the bowl down, until released.
steps.setup: Lift the bowl back up if they dive in. Try again.

skills.name: Check-in
skills.goal: Look back at you on walks without being asked.
skills.cue: None. Checking in is their idea.
skills.proofMark: they look back at you on their own.

steps.mark: they glance at your face on a walk.
steps.setup: Quiet street, loose leash, say nothing.

steps.mark: they look back at you within 10 steps.
steps.setup: Walk at a normal pace. Count steps in your head.

steps.mark: they look at you when you change direction.
steps.setup: Turn without a word.
steps.reward: Treat at your seam as they catch up.

steps.mark: they check in with a dog or person 20 m away.
steps.setup: Keep your distance so they can still eat.

steps.mark: they come back to check in without being called.
steps.setup: Fenced field or yard. Stand still and wait.
steps.reward: Treat, then send them off to sniff again.

skills.name: Heel
skills.goal: Walk at your left knee. For crowds, roads and the field.
skills.proofMark: they're still at your left knee.

steps.mark: they're at your left leg, shoulder level with your knee.
steps.setup: Lure them into place with your left hand.

steps.mark: they stay at your left knee as you take one step.
steps.setup: Step off with your left foot.

steps.mark: they hold position for 5 steps.
steps.setup: Count out loud if it helps you.
steps.reward: Treat at the seam, while walking.

steps.mark: they stay in position through a right turn and a left turn.
steps.setup: Slow down before each turn.

steps.mark: they hold position as you slow down and speed up.
steps.setup: Change pace for 5 steps at a time.

steps.mark: they heel 20 steps off leash in a fenced area.
steps.setup: Start right after a good on-leash round.
steps.reward: Treat, then a release to play.

skills.name: Emergency down
skills.goal: Drop on the spot from a distance. Stops a dog before a road or a hazard.
skills.cue: "Down!" said sharply, or one hand straight up

steps.mark: their elbows hit the floor within 1 second of the cue.
steps.setup: Standing together, cue once, sharply.
steps.reward: Toss the treat between their paws.

steps.mark: they drop 2 m away from you.
steps.setup: Step back first, then cue.
steps.reward: Walk in and treat between the paws.

steps.mark: they drop mid-stride as you walk together.
steps.setup: Keep walking a step after the cue the first few times.
steps.reward: Go back and treat between the paws.

steps.mark: they drop 10 m away.
steps.setup: Long line on. Cue once; don't repeat it.
steps.reward: Throw the treat to them so staying down pays.

steps.mark: they drop while trotting toward you.
steps.setup: A helper holds them, you call, then cue Down halfway.
steps.reward: Throw the treat to them, then call them in for a second one.

skills.name: Crate love
skills.goal: A crate that feels like a safe bedroom.

steps.mark: they step in to get a treat you tossed in.
steps.setup: Door open, treats tossed to the back.
steps.reward: The tossed treat; toss another while they're in.

steps.mark: they walk in on their own.
steps.setup: Stand near the crate and wait.

steps.mark: they lie down inside.
steps.setup: Just wait. No luring.

steps.mark: they stay calm with the door closed until the timer marks it.
steps.setup: Close the door, sit beside it. Start the hold.
steps.reward: Yes, then treat through the bars and open the door.

steps.mark: they stay calm while you step out for 30 seconds.
steps.setup: Give a chew first. Step out, step back.

steps.mark: they settle and nap in the crate.
steps.setup: After play and potty, quiet room, door open or closed.
steps.reward: Mark softly and drop a treat in now and then.

skills.name: Gentle mouth
skills.goal: Soft mouth on skin, and toys instead of hands.

steps.mark: their teeth touch your hand softly.
steps.setup: Gentle play. A hard bite means a quiet "ouch" and 5 seconds of stillness.
steps.reward: Keep playing. Play is the reward.

steps.mark: they take the toy you offer instead of your sleeve.
steps.setup: Keep a toy in your pocket; offer it before they grab.
steps.reward: Tug the toy with them for a few seconds.

steps.mark: they stay calm while you stroke their face.
steps.setup: After a walk, when they're sleepy.

steps.mark: they settle within a minute after play stops.
steps.setup: Stop play, sit down, say nothing.

skills.name: Handling
skills.goal: Relaxed about paws, ears, mouth and collar. Makes vet visits and grooming easy.

steps.mark: you touch a paw and they stay relaxed.
steps.setup: Touch, let go, mark.

steps.mark: they stay relaxed while you lift an ear or a lip.
steps.setup: One second at a time.

steps.mark: they stay relaxed when you take the collar.
steps.setup: Slip a finger under it from the side, not from above.
steps.reward: Treat while you still hold it.

steps.mark: they stay relaxed through a 2-second hold of any part.
steps.setup: Count two, let go.

steps.mark: they stay relaxed for a towel rub or a few brush strokes.
steps.setup: Short, gentle strokes.

steps.mark: they stay relaxed when a friend handles a paw.
steps.setup: The friend touches; you mark and treat.
steps.reward: Your treat, right after the touch.

skills.name: Alone time
skills.goal: Calm when left alone. Built up before any crying starts.

steps.mark: you come back after 10 seconds and they stayed calm.
steps.setup: Give a chew, step out, close the door.
steps.reward: A calm hello and a treat. No big greeting.

steps.mark: they stayed calm for a minute alone.
steps.setup: Same setup, a minute away.

steps.mark: they stayed calm for 5 minutes.
steps.setup: Film them once to check they really settle.

steps.mark: they stayed calm for 15 minutes.
steps.setup: A walk or a meal first.

steps.mark: they stayed calm for 30 minutes.
steps.setup: Leave the house this time.

skills.name: Hallway retrieve
skills.goal: Bring things back. The seed of every retrieve, for sport puppies and family dogs.

steps.mark: they chase a toy rolled down the hallway.
steps.setup: Close the hallway doors so there's nowhere to run off to.

steps.mark: they pick the toy up.
steps.setup: A soft toy that's easy to carry.

steps.mark: they turn and come toward you with it.
steps.setup: Sit on the floor at the closed end. Clap softly.

steps.mark: they bring it to your hand.
steps.setup: Hold your hand low and still.
steps.reward: Trade for a treat, then throw again right away.

steps.mark: they hold it in front of you for a second before the trade.
steps.setup: Wait a beat before taking it.
steps.reward: Trade for a treat and throw again.

skills.name: Chin rest
skills.goal: Chin on your hand while you check eyes, ears and teeth. Their way of saying "go ahead".

steps.mark: their chin rests on your open palm.
steps.setup: Hold your palm flat, just below their chin.

steps.mark: their chin stays down until the timer marks it.
steps.setup: Start the hold once the chin is down.

steps.mark: their chin rests on a folded towel on your knee.
steps.setup: Sit on the floor with the towel.
steps.reward: Treat while the chin is down.

steps.mark: their chin stays down while you lift an ear.
steps.setup: If the chin lifts, stop touching. That's their say.
steps.reward: Treat while the chin is down.

steps.mark: the chin rest holds in the vet's lobby.
steps.setup: Bring the towel and great treats.
steps.reward: Treat while the chin is down.

skills.name: Nail care
skills.goal: Calm nail trims, one nail at a time.

steps.mark: they let you hold a paw for 2 seconds.
steps.setup: Chin rest first, then lift the paw.

steps.mark: the clipper touches a nail and they stay relaxed.
steps.setup: Just a touch. No cutting yet.

steps.mark: you trim one nail tip calmly.
steps.setup: A tiny tip. Stop after one.

steps.mark: you trim a whole paw calmly.
steps.setup: Treat after each nail.

steps.mark: you trim all four paws in one sitting, calmly.
steps.setup: Split it over days if needed.
steps.reward: Treat per nail, jackpot at the end.

skills.name: Tooth brushing
skills.goal: Teeth brushed in under a minute, without a fuss.

steps.mark: they stay relaxed while you lift a lip.
steps.setup: Chin rest, then lift.

steps.mark: they stay relaxed with your finger on their teeth.
steps.setup: A dab of dog toothpaste on your finger.

steps.mark: the brush touches their teeth and they stay relaxed.
steps.setup: Dog toothpaste on the brush.

steps.mark: you brush the front teeth for 5 seconds.
steps.setup: Small circles.

steps.mark: you brush all the outer surfaces.
steps.setup: Back teeth last.

skills.name: Vet visit
skills.goal: Happy visits so the real ones are easy.

steps.mark: they take treats calmly in the vet's parking lot.
steps.setup: Just visit. Leave after a few treats.

steps.mark: they take treats calmly in the lobby.
steps.setup: Ask the front desk; most clinics welcome happy visits.

steps.mark: they step on the scale.
steps.setup: Lure on once if needed.

steps.mark: they stay relaxed in the exam room.
steps.setup: Do a chin rest in there.

steps.mark: they stay relaxed on the exam table.
steps.setup: With the staff's help.

skills.name: Car manners
skills.goal: Load up on cue, ride calmly, wait to get out.

steps.mark: they jump or step into the car on "Load up".
steps.setup: Small dogs: lift on cue. A ramp for big or older dogs.

steps.mark: they lie down in the car.
steps.setup: Engine off first.

steps.mark: they stay settled for a 5-minute ride.
steps.setup: A helper drives; you mark.

steps.mark: they wait at the open door until released.
steps.setup: Leash on before the door opens.

skills.name: Four on the floor
skills.goal: Greet people without jumping up.

steps.mark: all four paws are on the floor as you come home.
steps.setup: Toss treats at their feet as you walk in.

steps.mark: four paws stay down as a helper walks up.
steps.setup: Leash on. The helper turns away if they jump.

steps.mark: paws stay down while the helper pets them.
steps.setup: Short petting, then the helper steps back.

steps.mark: paws stay down when a new person says hi.
steps.setup: Ask a friendly stranger to help.

skills.name: Doorbell calm
skills.goal: The doorbell means "go to your mat", not "bark and rush".

steps.mark: they go to the mat after the doorbell sound.
steps.setup: Play a doorbell sound on another phone, then cue Mat.

steps.mark: they stay on the mat while you open the door.
steps.setup: No one there yet.

steps.mark: they go to the mat at a real knock.
steps.setup: A helper knocks outside.

steps.mark: they stay on the mat while a guest walks in.
steps.setup: The guest ignores them until released.
steps.reward: Treat on the mat, then release to say hi.

skills.name: Calm in public
skills.goal: Settle at a café, a park bench or a busy entrance.

steps.mark: they settle on their mat at a quiet park.
steps.setup: Bring the mat and a chew.

steps.mark: they settle at an outdoor café table.
steps.setup: A quiet time of day.

steps.mark: they settle near a busy entrance.
steps.setup: Stand back from the doors.

steps.mark: they stay settled for 15 minutes.
steps.setup: Mark calm moments every minute or so.

skills.name: Polite dog meetings
skills.goal: Pass other dogs calmly, and greet only when invited.

steps.mark: they walk calmly with another dog 15 m away.
steps.setup: A friend's calm dog, walking the same direction.

steps.mark: they walk calmly at 10 m.
steps.setup: Close the gap slowly.

steps.mark: they walk calmly at 5 m.
steps.setup: Keep leashes loose.

steps.mark: they sniff for 3 seconds and come away on "Let's go".
steps.setup: Count three, cue, walk off.

skills.name: Whistle signals
skills.goal: Sit, come and turn on the whistle, so you can steer a dog 100 yards out.
skills.cue: One blast = sit · a trill = come · two pips = turn
skills.proofMark: they answer the whistle the moment it sounds.

steps.mark: they sit as the single blast ends.
steps.setup: Dog beside you. One blast (tap Sit on the whistle bar), then your usual sit cue. Soon the blast alone means sit.

steps.mark: they sit on the blast with no other cue.
steps.setup: Blast only. If no sit in 2 seconds, help with your hand signal.

steps.mark: they turn and run in on the trill.
steps.setup: Start at 5 m in the house or yard. Trill once, back up a step.
steps.reward: Treat at your knees, then a second one.

steps.mark: they turn toward you on two pips while trotting ahead.
steps.setup: On a walk when they're 5 to 10 m ahead. Change direction as you pip.
steps.reward: Treat as they reach you, then send them on.

steps.mark: they sit on the blast 20 m away.
steps.setup: Long line on. One blast; never repeat it.
steps.reward: Walk out and treat while they sit, or toss it to them.

skills.name: Retrieve
skills.goal: Chase, pick up, carry back and deliver to hand. Taught with rewards; no force fetch.
skills.cue: Their name sends them; "Give" for the delivery
skills.proofMark: they bring it straight back and deliver to hand.

steps.mark: they pick up a bumper tossed 3 m away.
steps.setup: A soft canvas or plastic bumper. A short, exciting toss down a hallway or narrow yard.
steps.reward: Cheer. The next steps pay with food.

steps.mark: they turn back toward you carrying it.
steps.setup: Turn and jog away a few steps to draw them in.

steps.mark: they hold the bumper calmly in front of you until the timer marks it.
steps.setup: Hand under their chin, no pulling. Start the hold.

steps.mark: they carry it beside you for 10 steps.
steps.setup: Walk slowly with your hand near the bumper.

steps.mark: they put the bumper in your hand.
steps.setup: Stand still, hand open at chest height. Say "Give".
steps.reward: Trade for a treat, then throw again right away.

steps.mark: they wait for their name, then go.
steps.setup: Hold the collar lightly, toss, count two, say their name.
steps.reward: The retrieve is the reward; treat on delivery.

skills.name: Bumper and bird intro
skills.goal: Happy to carry bumpers, wings and birds.
skills.proofMark: they carry it back gently and deliver to hand.

steps.mark: they pick up and carry a soft bumper.
steps.setup: Short, fun tosses.

steps.mark: they carry a plastic or canvas bumper back.
steps.setup: Same short tosses.

steps.mark: they retrieve a bumper with a wing taped on.
steps.setup: A fresh or frozen wing, taped on with electrical tape.

steps.mark: they pick up and carry a thawed duck or pigeon.
steps.setup: Short, easy tosses. A cold bird is less tempting to chew.

steps.mark: they retrieve a freshly shot bird calmly.
steps.setup: With an experienced trainer or hunting mentor, following your state's rules on birds.
steps.reward: Big praise and a treat on delivery.

skills.name: Gun conditioning
skills.goal: Gunfire means the fun is happening. Always far away first, and never at a nervous dog.
gear: a helper with a blank pistol

steps.mark: they keep chasing the bumper happily as the shot goes off 100 yards away.
steps.setup: A helper 100 yd off with a blank pistol. They fire the moment your dog is chasing a thrown bumper.
steps.reward: The retrieve, plus a treat on delivery.

steps.mark: they stay happy with the shot 50 yards away.
steps.setup: Same setup. Only move closer after happy sessions.

steps.mark: they stay happy with the shot 30 yards away.
steps.setup: Same setup.

steps.mark: they stay happy with the shot 20 yards away.
steps.setup: Same setup.

steps.mark: they stay happy with a shotgun fired 75 yards away during a retrieve.
steps.setup: A safe range, ear protection for people, the helper far off.

steps.mark: they stay happy when you fire beside them.
steps.setup: Only after several happy sessions at every step. Gun pointed well away.
steps.reward: A bird or bumper to retrieve.

skills.name: Steadiness
skills.goal: Sit still while things fall and fly, until sent by name.
skills.cue: Sit, then their name to send
skills.proofMark: they stay sitting until you say their name.

steps.mark: they stay sitting while you drop a bumper at your feet.
steps.setup: Leash on, your foot on the leash. Drop it, wait 2 seconds, mark.
steps.reward: Treat to them while they sit. Then pick it up yourself, or send them.

steps.mark: they stay sitting as you toss a bumper 3 m.
steps.setup: Send them only every other time; you pick up the rest. Staying has to pay too.

steps.mark: they stay sitting through a 20-yard throw.
steps.setup: Same: send only some of the time.

steps.mark: they stay sitting through a throw with a shot.
steps.setup: A helper fires a blank as you throw. Only after Gun conditioning step 3.

steps.mark: they stay sitting through two throws.
steps.setup: Throws wide apart.

steps.mark: they stay sitting while another dog retrieves.
steps.setup: A calm partner dog 3 m to the side.
steps.reward: Treat while they sit, then their own turn.

skills.name: Single marks
skills.goal: Watch a bird fall and go straight to it.
skills.proofMark: a clean pickup and straight return.

steps.mark: a clean pickup and return on a 10-yard mark.
steps.setup: A helper throws with a shout or duck call so the dog looks. Send on their name after it lands.

steps.mark: a clean retrieve on a 25-yard mark.
steps.setup: Short grass, wind at your back.

steps.mark: a clean retrieve on a 50-yard mark.
steps.setup: White bumpers show up best.

steps.mark: a clean retrieve on a 75-yard mark.
steps.setup: Use the distance tracker to check it.

steps.mark: a clean retrieve on a 100-yard mark.
steps.setup: A helper with a duck call or launcher.

steps.mark: a clean retrieve from tall grass or cattails at 50 yards.
steps.setup: Shorter again in new cover.

steps.mark: a clean retrieve across a ditch or into the wind.
steps.setup: The dog should cross, not run around.

skills.name: Water entry
skills.goal: Into the water with confidence, straight to the bird.
skills.proofMark: a straight, confident entry and swim to the bumper.

steps.mark: they wade in on their own to chest depth.
steps.setup: Warm water and a gentle bank. Wade in yourself. In cold water keep it short and dry them off after.
steps.reward: Treats and play in the shallows.

steps.mark: they swim a few strokes to a bumper.
steps.setup: Toss it just past their depth.

steps.mark: a clean 10-yard water retrieve.
steps.setup: Throw parallel to the shore at first.

steps.mark: a clean 25-yard water retrieve.
steps.setup: Straight out from the shore.

steps.mark: a clean 50-yard water retrieve.
steps.setup: Calm water, no wind.

steps.mark: they go straight in at an angle instead of running the bank.
steps.setup: Throw at a 45 degree angle to the shore.

steps.mark: they swim past decoys to the bumper and leave the decoys alone.
steps.setup: Three decoys first, wide apart.

skills.name: Water delivery
skills.goal: Out of the water and straight to hand before shaking.
skills.proofMark: they come straight out and deliver before shaking.

steps.mark: they carry the bumper out of the water without dropping it.
steps.setup: Stand at the water's edge.

steps.mark: they come straight to you instead of shaking first.
steps.setup: Back up 2 m from the edge.

steps.mark: they deliver to hand from 5 m back, then shake.
steps.setup: Back up 5 m. Take the bumper before the shake.

skills.name: Doubles
skills.goal: Remember two falls and pick up both.
skills.cue: Their name, then a hand line to the memory bird
skills.proofMark: both birds picked up cleanly, last first.

steps.mark: they pick up the last throw, then go back for the first.
steps.setup: Two throws 90 degrees apart at 25 yd. After the first delivery, line them up on the memory bird.

steps.mark: they remember the first bird after delivering the second.
steps.setup: Same, with a pause before the second send.

steps.mark: they pick up both with the throws 45 degrees apart.
steps.setup: Keep the distance at 25 yd.

steps.mark: they pick up one bird on land and one in water.
steps.setup: Water bird last thrown.

steps.mark: they pick up both at 50 yards.
steps.setup: Wide angles again at the new distance.

skills.name: Lining
skills.goal: Run straight where you point, toward a bird they didn't see fall.
skills.proofMark: a straight line to the bumper.

steps.mark: they run straight to a visible pile of bumpers on "Back".
steps.setup: Dog at your left, your hand flat beside their head pointing at the pile.

steps.mark: they run straight to the pile at 25 yards.
steps.setup: Same.

steps.mark: they run straight to the pile at 50 yards.
steps.setup: Same.

steps.mark: they run straight to a single bumper they watched you place.
steps.setup: Walk out with them, place it, walk back.

steps.mark: they run straight to a bumper they didn't see placed.
steps.setup: Plant it before the session.

skills.name: Handling casts
skills.goal: Stop on the whistle and go where your arm sends them.
skills.cue: One blast = stop; arm signals "Over" and "Back"
skills.proofMark: a stop on the whistle and the right cast.

steps.mark: they stop and sit facing you on the whistle, 10 yards out.
steps.setup: Send to a pile; blast halfway.
steps.reward: Walk out and treat, then send them on.

steps.mark: they go left or right to the bumper you point to.
steps.setup: Dog sitting on a mound, bumpers to each side.

steps.mark: they turn and go straight back on "Back".
steps.setup: Bumpers behind them.

steps.mark: they take a correct cast 30 yards out.
steps.setup: The baseball-diamond drill: piles at first, second and third base.

steps.mark: they stop and take a correct cast 50 yards out.
steps.setup: Same drill, bigger diamond.

skills.name: Blind retrieves
skills.goal: Find a bird they never saw fall, guided by you.
skills.proofMark: the bird found with a clean line or a handle or two.

steps.mark: a clean pickup on a 25-yard blind.
steps.setup: Plant the bumper before you bring the dog out.

steps.mark: a clean 50-yard blind.
steps.setup: Clear terrain.

steps.mark: a 100-yard blind with a straight line or one handle.
steps.setup: Use the distance tracker.

steps.mark: they take one stop and cast and find it.
steps.setup: Plant it slightly off a natural line.

steps.mark: a blind across a pond or channel.
steps.setup: Short water first.

skills.name: Hunt dead
skills.goal: Search an area for a crippled bird and bring it back.
skills.proofMark: they search the area and bring back the hidden bird.

steps.mark: they search on "Dead bird" and find a hidden bumper in short grass.
steps.setup: Hide it 5 m away; let them watch you walk out.

steps.mark: they find it in tall grass or brush.
steps.setup: Hide it before you bring them.

steps.mark: they find a hidden duck after a 2-minute wait.
steps.setup: The scent has time to spread; send them downwind.

skills.name: Blind and boat manners
skills.goal: Still and quiet in a blind or boat while calls blow and guns move.
skills.proofMark: they stay still and quiet on their spot.

steps.mark: they hold place on a dog stand or in a boat on land until the timer marks it.
steps.setup: The stand on flat ground first.

steps.mark: they stay put while a duck call blows.
steps.setup: Blow a call, or play the Duck call from the sound ladder.

steps.mark: they stay put while you stand, sit and shoulder an empty gun.
steps.setup: Slow movements first.

steps.mark: they stay quiet and still in a blind for 10 minutes.
steps.setup: A practice blind or a layout spot.

steps.mark: they walk past decoys without picking them up.
steps.setup: On leash, then off.

skills.name: Bird intro and sight point
skills.goal: Love birds, and freeze at the sight of one.
skills.proofMark: they freeze and hold on the bird.

steps.mark: they chase a wing on a flirt pole.
steps.setup: A wing tied to a flirt pole line. Drag it in circles; let them chase, not catch.
steps.reward: Let them catch it now and then: the catch is the reward.

steps.mark: they freeze, staring, when the wing stops.
steps.setup: Stop the wing dead in the grass and wait.
steps.reward: Flick the wing away so they can chase again.

steps.mark: they hold the freeze until the timer marks it.
steps.setup: Stop the wing, start the hold.
steps.reward: Release them to chase the wing.

steps.mark: they hold the freeze until the timer marks it.
steps.setup: Same.
steps.reward: Release them to chase the wing.

steps.mark: they point a pigeon in a launcher.
steps.setup: With an experienced trainer, check cord on. Release the bird only while they hold.

steps.mark: they point a quail from a call-back pen.
steps.setup: With a mentor or at a preserve.

skills.name: Whoa
skills.goal: Stop and stand still on one word, taught with rewards on a board.
skills.proofMark: they stand still on "Whoa" until released.

steps.mark: they stand still on a raised board.
steps.setup: A low table or board. Lift them on, a hand under the belly at first.
steps.reward: Treat to the mouth while they stand.

steps.mark: they stay standing on "Whoa" until the timer marks it.
steps.setup: Say "Whoa", start the hold. Tap Miss if they sit or step.
steps.reward: Treat while they stand, then release.

steps.mark: they stand still on "Whoa" on the ground.
steps.setup: Right beside the board at first.

steps.mark: they stop and stand when you say "Whoa" mid-walk.
steps.setup: Slow walk, leash loose.

steps.mark: they stop and stand on "Whoa" 10 m ahead of you.
steps.setup: Check cord on.
steps.reward: Walk up and treat while they stand.

steps.mark: they stop and stand on "Whoa" 30 m ahead.
steps.setup: Check cord on.
steps.reward: Walk up and treat while they stand.

skills.name: Point duration
skills.goal: Hold point while you walk in to flush.
skills.proofMark: they hold point until released.
gear: a wing or a bird in a launcher

steps.mark: they hold point until the timer marks it.
steps.setup: Wing on a pole, or a planted bird with a mentor.
steps.reward: Release to the wing or the flush.

steps.mark: they hold point until the timer marks it.
steps.setup: Same.
steps.reward: Release to the wing or the flush.

steps.mark: they hold point until the timer marks it.
steps.setup: Same.
steps.reward: Release to the wing or the flush.

steps.mark: they hold point while you walk past their nose.
steps.setup: Walk a wide arc first, then closer.

steps.mark: they hold point while you kick the grass for the bird.
steps.setup: Kick around the bird for a few seconds.

skills.name: Steady to wing
skills.goal: Stay on point while the bird flies.
skills.proofMark: they stay put as the bird flies.

steps.mark: they hold point while the launcher fires.
steps.setup: Check cord on. A helper fires the launcher on your nod.
steps.reward: Release to hunt on or to a retrieve.

steps.mark: they hold as a bird flies away.
steps.setup: Same, with a live bird and a mentor.

steps.mark: they stay steady through two flushes in a row.
steps.setup: Two launchers.

skills.name: Steady to shot
skills.goal: Stay on point through the flush and the shot.
skills.proofMark: they stay put through the flush and the shot.

steps.mark: they stay steady through the flush and a blank 30 yards away.
steps.setup: A helper fires as the bird lifts.

steps.mark: they stay steady with the blank 10 yards away.
steps.setup: Same.

steps.mark: they stay steady when you shoot.
steps.setup: Safe direction, the dog well behind your line of fire.
steps.reward: Release to the retrieve or to hunt on.

skills.name: Steady to fall
skills.goal: Hold until the bird is down and you send them.
skills.proofMark: they hold through the fall and go only on their name.

steps.mark: they hold until the bird is down and you send them.
steps.setup: A helper shoots; you stay near the dog.

steps.mark: they go only on their name, to retrieve or to hunt on.
steps.setup: Vary it: sometimes send, sometimes pick up the bird yourself.

skills.name: Backing
skills.goal: Stop and honor another dog's point.
skills.proofMark: they stop on sight of the pointing dog.

steps.mark: they stop on sight of a cardboard pointing dog 10 m away.
steps.setup: Stand the cutout in short grass; walk them up to it.

steps.mark: they stop when they come on a dog decoy in cover.
steps.setup: Hide it so they find it suddenly.

steps.mark: they stop on a real pointing dog 20 m away.
steps.setup: A steady partner dog on a planted bird.

steps.mark: they stop on a real pointing dog 50 m away.
steps.setup: Same, bigger field.

skills.name: Covey and singles
skills.goal: Handle a covey rise and work the scattered singles.
skills.proofMark: a covey pointed and singles worked slowly.

steps.mark: they point a covey find and hold.
steps.setup: A preserve or call-back pen, with a mentor.

steps.mark: they stay steady as the covey flushes.
steps.setup: Check cord on.

steps.mark: they work slowly and point scattered singles.
steps.setup: Head where the birds landed.

skills.name: Range and handling
skills.goal: Hunt out front at gun range and turn on the whistle.
skills.proofMark: they hunt in range and answer the whistle.
gear: a long line or GPS collar

steps.mark: they swing back to check in within 50 yards.
steps.setup: Open field. Walk with the wind in your face.
steps.reward: Treat when they check in, then send them on.

steps.mark: they turn on two pips from 50 yards or more.
steps.setup: Pip as you change direction.
steps.reward: Treat when they reach you, sometimes.

steps.mark: they come in on the trill from 100 yards in cover.
steps.setup: Use the distance tracker to check the range.
